title: Meme Coin Trading Bot

versions.changed: First version. Found the backtests were measuring 5-month outcomes against a 4-hour strategy, and that 96% of the tweet data was synthetic test data. Also found the one real signal: coins with an existing market were 17x more likely to succeed than fresh launches. Bot paused pending a direction decision.
versions.title: Meme Coin Trading Bot

tagline: A bot that reads crypto Twitter and is supposed to buy meme coins on its own. The machine works; the strategy is the part we can't prove yet.
